description: Options [{"import-sources-order":"any"}]. Sources: an import (or import-equals require) fails when its module path sorts before the path of the import directly before it (through comments; any other statement ends the block), after TSLint's transform (any), with relative paths (./ or /) sorting after library paths, as compare() does. Named imports: the first specifier whose next specifier sorts before it, as findUnsortedPair (case-insensitive). Not modelled: blank lines ending a block (trivia), grouped-imports/groups, module-source-path basename.

finding.message: Named imports must be alphabetized ($B before $A).
